Bug_Title: MS: May expose internal static state by storing a mutable object into a static field (EI_EXPOSE_STATIC_REP2)
Bug_Details:
This code stores a reference to an externally mutable object into a static
 field.
 If unchecked changes to
 the mutable object would compromise security or other
 important properties, you will need to do something different.
Storing a copy of the object is better approach in many situations.
Bug_Explanation: A reference to an externally mutable object is stored in a static field of BuggyClass. This exposes the internal state of BuggyClass and makes it possible for other parts of the program to unintentionally modify the state.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when we modify the mutable object through the static method modifyMutableObject() in BuggyClass and then compare it with its initial value. Since the modification is visible to all parts of the program, the initial value will not be equal to the new value, causing the test to fail.
